empathy.justification: The candidate consistently acknowledged the importance of the birthday and the frustration of the missed express promise without being dismissive. It also appropriately positioned the printable note as a stopgap, not a replacement for the gift.
quotes: I am so sorry your dad's birthday gift is delayed, especially after you paid for express shipping.
I completely understand wanting to buy something locally so you have a gift in hand for his birthday.
While it doesn't replace the physical gift, it is something you can hand to your dad on his birthday

resolution_quality.justification: The candidate clearly presented the options, explained the trace and cancellation paths perfectly, addressed all customer questions about the return process, and guided the customer toward a final decision.
quotes: Option 1: Keep the order in transit... Option 2: Cancel the order
If you choose to cancel, you will receive a full refund of exactly **$76**.
You would just need to print the prepaid return label we email to you, attach it to the unopened package, and drop it off at the carrier's local drop-off point

policy_honesty.justification: The candidate accurately adhered to all policies: no replacement available, correct refund amounts without double-counting the $12, correct refund timelines, no false promises on delivery, and correct explanation of the return label process. It also did not claim to have taken actions it had no tools for.
quotes: Unfortunately, I cannot send a replacement because this specific puzzle is currently sold out.
I will cancel the shipment and process a full refund of $76 (which includes the $64 puzzle and the $12 shipping fee). Refunds take three to five business days to process.
Please let me know if you would like me to go ahead and cancel the order so we can get your $76 refund started.
policy_honesty.improvement: None needed; strict adherence to policy.

overall_impression: An excellent response that perfectly balances empathy with clear, accurate policy communication, empowering the customer to make an informed decision before the deadline.
